scenes.text: It's money Indians forgot in old bank accounts.
scenes.sub: Untouched for 10 years → moved to an RBI fund.

scenes.text: It still belongs to them. Or their families.
Search your parents' names on RBI's UDGAM portal.
Family group mein bhejo. Kisi ka paisa wait kar raha hai.

caption:
₹86,917 crore of Indians' money is lying unclaimed with the RBI. Some of it could be your family's.

As of 30 June 2026, unclaimed bank deposits in the RBI's Depositor Education and Awareness Fund stood at ₹86,917 crore (Finance Ministry, Rajya Sabha). Accounts untouched for 10 years move there, but the money stays payable to owners and heirs. Search on the RBI's UDGAM portal.

Source: Finance Ministry reply in Rajya Sabha, Aug 2026

Family group mein bhejo. Kisi ke dadaji ka paisa abhi bhi wait kar raha hai.

scenes.text: Someone dies on an Indian road.
Us dost ko bhejo jo helmet nahi pehenta.

caption:
Someone dies on an Indian road every 3 minutes.

India recorded 1,77,175 road deaths in 2024, about 20 every hour, per the Road Transport Ministry. Two-wheeler riders were 46.2% of those killed, pedestrians 20.6%.

Source: Road Transport Ministry report, via ETV Bharat/PTI

Us dost ko bhejo jo bolta hai "5 minute ke liye helmet ki kya zaroorat".

#PostrNews #HiddenIndia #RoadSafety
